modifier_profile.effect_summary: After the initial grace window, expired nicotine support contributes -4 Mood Target. A Nicotine Patch manages the habit for about 60 active-play minutes and contributes +4 Mood while managed. Non-Smokers can receive the small capped Focus benefit instead; the support does not stack without limit.
modifier_profile.implementation_surface: Nicotine Patch item use + server-authoritative Trait Support + REBIRTH Mood/Skill gain
